name: Database System Implementation
summary: How a database engine works inside: storage, buffer management, indexing, query processing and optimization, concurrency control and recovery.

topics.name: Storage: disks, pages, files and record layout
Indexing: B+ trees, hash indexes and LSM trees
Query processing: external sorting and join algorithms
Query optimization: cost models and plan search
Concurrency control: two-phase locking, MVCC and optimistic methods
Column stores and analytical query engines
Distributed databases: partitioning, replication and distributed transactions
